title: Semester Survival: Jay's University Run
description: Run through the residence, Nairobi student township, university campus and city as Jay. Switch lanes, jump, slide, collect university rewards and survive eight semesters.

maker.name: Joseph Ombati
maker.bio: Creator and game director of Semester Survival: Jay's University Run.

touch.swipe: Swipe left/right to change lanes, up to jump, down to slide

instructions: Run through four university districts. Avoid desks, book stacks, crowded corridors, construction barriers and deadlines. Collect credits and timed power-ups. Progress through eight semesters.
